verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no statement about API versioning practices or a deprecation policy. The only hint is the '/v2/' segment in the developer-docs URL, which at most implies a versioned path and documents no versioning scheme, deprecation timelines, sunset notices or changelog. Probes found no OpenAPI spec either. API lifecycle policy is a fair question for a SaaS CRM with a public API, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
